title: Oddball
description: A chicken farmer and his granddaughter train a dog to protect a penguin sanctuary from foxes.

title: Let Us In
description: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town.

title: The Snow Queen 2
description: After the trolls' victory over the Snow Queen, Orm claims that he is destined to marry the princess and inherit great power.

title: Pegasus: Pony With a Broken Wing
description: When Sydney and a neighbor boy find a mysterious pony that has an injured wing, they secretly heal the creature while racing to save Sydney's family ranch from developers.

title: A Mermaid's Tale
description: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

title: The Blue Elephant
description: A young, carefree elephant (Thomas Sharkey) becomes separated from his herd and seeks help from new friends.

title: Cricket & Antoinette
description: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

title: Bark Ranger
description: Jack lives in a national park with his mom, dad and dog Ranger, and when he meets Chloe, the two become fast friends. When Jack finds a treasure map, he and Chloe are kidnapped by robbers, and only Ranger can save the day.

title: Space Chimps
description: Ham III (Andy Samberg) is the grandson of the first chimpanzee who first blasted into outer space. He and two other chimp astronauts go on a dangerous mission through a black hole. Landing on an inhabited planet, the space-faring simians must help depose a planetary tyrant, then find a way back to their own world.

title: Elephant Kingdom
description: A brave elephant asks a courageous troop of young elephants to help him rescue his wife from a human.

title: An Elephant's Journey
description: While living in Africa with his aunt, a teen boy teams up with a huge, friendly elephant to take down a dangerous gang of local poachers.

title: A Dog and Pony Show
description: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals.

title: My Sweet Monster
description: Princess Barbara is secretly in love with Prince Edward. When the sneaky post clerk Weasel demands the king to marry him to Barbara, she flees. Sweet monster Bogey does everything in his might to help Barbara save the kingdom.
